title: Everspin Expands MRAM Push into AI Servers, Data Centers, Satellite Systems
summary: EE Times interviews Everspin CEO Sanjeev Aggarwal on MRAM for AI servers, data centers and satellites, including CXL, persistent memory and NOR flash alternatives.
body_markdown:
By: Yashasvini Razdan


In an exclusive interview with EE Times, Everspin President and CEO Sanjeev Aggarwal discusses the growing role of magnetoresistive random-access memory (MRAM) in AI infrastructure, data centers and satellite systems. The article explores how Everspin's persistent MRAM technology addresses memory performance, data retention and reliability challenges, including emerging opportunities as NOR flash supply tightens. Aggarwal also highlights Everspin's CXL-based MRAM demonstration for AI workloads, its STT-MRAM deployment in satellite systems, collaboration with MaxLinear on AI server applications and plans to expand U.S. semiconductor manufacturing capacity.


[Read the full article in EE Times](https://www.eetimes.com/everspin-expands-mram-push-into-ai-servers-data-centers-satellite-systems/)
